task_title: Decouple Floor 2 generated equipment rarity from base non-armor stats

plan_review.notes: Plan review by gpt-5.6-sol. The core separation (base-driven armor, affix-driven non-armor power) was found sound. 3 blocking concerns identified and resolved: (1) unused import of generatedEquipmentBaseHasNonArmorStatBonus — fixed by removing from import; (2) illegal-base error code removed from union type but still thrown — fixed by adding illegal-base back to the error union as a defense-in-depth tripwire code; (3) floor2-reward-pool.test.ts still tested the old source-independent contract — fixed by rewriting to assert the new affix-only model (zero non-armor at Common, effect-sum equality at Uncommon/Rare). Also fixed: travelers-cloak rarity assertion in resolver test (incorrectly assumed Common draws never happened after decoupling). 2 non-blocking items: coverage suggestion and explicit inherentArmor field suggestion — not acted on as the current contract is fully covered by updated tests and the suggestion adds indirection with no second consumer.

rounds.notes: Code review by claude-opus-4.8. Two critical build-breaking findings: (1) unused import generatedEquipmentBaseHasNonArmorStatBonus causing TS6133 under noUnusedLocals — fixed by removing from import; (2) illegal-base error code thrown in _assertGeneratedRewardInstanceLegal but not in error union TS2345 — fixed by adding illegal-base back to union as post-generation tripwire. Reviewer confirmed armor-only copy logic is correct for all targetKind values (weapon/armor/accessory) and that downstream frozen.statBonuses consumers use Object.entries or ?? 0 so fewer keys cause no crashes.
